Download a basic PDF document with download_documents enabled

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from crawlberg import scrape, create_engine, CrawlConfig

async def main() -> None:
    engine_config = CrawlConfig(download_documents=True, respect_robots_txt=False)
    engine = create_engine(engine_config)
    url = "https://example.com"
    result = await scrape(engine, url)
    print((result.downloaded_document.mime_type if result.downloaded_document else None))

asyncio.run(main())
```
